n: Unplugged assignments for K-12 AI education
t: A short AI Matters article that introduces two unplugged AI activities for K-12.
steps: Find the article in AI Matters volume 7, issue 1, pages 10 to 12.
Use the DOI 10.1145/3465074.3465078 to locate it.
Try the semantic network activity yourself.
Adjust the task for your grade band.
Test it with a small group before the full class.
